entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Demigod of Theros, formerly a human oracle of Heliod, friend and lover of Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God Daxos served and Elspeth championed.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker, Daxos's lover and Heliod's champion.

entities.name: Lidia
entities.description: Daxos's mother, who traded herself for him.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who bargained to free Daxos.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of mothers who sent aid.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Dead freed from the Underworld, wearing golden masks.

events.summary: Lidia takes Daxos to Athreos; he speaks and is revealed to be an oracle; Erebos sends Athreos to claim him.
events.quote: Athreos was sent to claim the child

events.summary: Lidia trades herself for her son and Karametra's emissary takes Daxos to safety.
events.quote: Lidia traded herself for her son

events.summary: Elspeth, helped by Daxos, slays Polukranos, becoming Heliod's champion.
events.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where many had failed, slaying it

events.summary: Elspeth and Daxos travel to Akros, where Xenagos tells her how to destroy the army by raising the river.
events.quote: they raised the river that ran through Akros and swept the army away

events.summary: Daxos and Elspeth realize their feelings after the victory celebration.
events.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realized their feelings for each other

events.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth, who kills Daxos while lashing out at the Phyrexian Obliterator in her memory.
events.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

events.summary: Daxos is freed from the Underworld as one of the Returned, searching for Elspeth.
events.quote: Daxos was freed from the Underworld in a cruel bargain with Erebos

events.summary: Elevated to demigod, Daxos is reformed by Heliod to destroy signs of other divinities in Meletis.
events.quote: He was reformed by Heliod with the task of destroying every sign of other divinities in Meletis

events.summary: Daxos fights in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Daxos fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: the friend, mentor, and lover of the Planeswalker Elspeth Tirel
he has no choice but to obey his god
succeeded where many had failed, slaying it
He controlled her and brought back her darkest memory
